name: La rosa de Guadalupe
description: Stories about people who get into problems who use the help of Virgin Mary and where a rose appears and their problems are solved.

videos.title: My Daughter Lives
videos.overview: Eleven years ago, a poor woman's house was burned down with her daughter inside. Since the body was never found, the woman asks for the miracle of finding her daughter, as she knows she did not die in the fire.

videos.title: U-turn
videos.overview: Returning from her bachelorette party, a young woman is involved in a car accident and falls into a coma for seven years.

videos.title: Love Knocks On My Door
videos.overview: An amateur writer enters a short story contest and eventually realizes that the contest organizer is the same boy she had a crush on as a child.

videos.title: Whatever it Takes
videos.overview: Due to emotional blackmail from her boyfriend, a girl becomes obsessed with her weight until she becomes anorexic.

videos.title: Calculation Error
videos.overview: A mother discovers that her son has HIV and that he has impregnated a young woman. The mother rejects the young woman and the baby, soon after her son dies.

videos.title: Cristinita
videos.overview: Due to stress, an elderly woman's son has a heart attack and becomes paralyzed. The mother moves in with him and tries to help the family, but her daughter-in-law kicks her out because she thinks she's a nuisance.

videos.title: Broken Promises
videos.overview: Nestor is a boxer who is forced to retire when he gets badly hurt in a boxing match, promising his girlfriend that he'll never box again. Years later, a tragedy happens that will make him go back to boxing and break his promise to his wife.

videos.title: Second Opportunity
videos.overview: A young man who has just graduated from high school throws a party where he ends up drunk and is accused of killing someone. Twenty years later, the young man is released from prison and the terrible truth about the murderer is revealed.

videos.title: Silent Threat
videos.overview: The mother of a young woman has breast cancer. Her father's ignorance is holding up the whole healing process. As time goes by, the mother is not getting better and now has to undergo chemotherapy because her cancer is not healing.

videos.title: Hope of Forgiveness
videos.overview: A woman becomes pregnant and dies during childbirth, but the baby survives. The husband harbors deep resentment toward his daughter for the death of his wife and kicks her out of the house, unaware of the grave mistake he is making.

videos.title: One Look
videos.overview: A young man steals because his mother is very ill, but when she finds out, she kicks him out of the house. The young man plays Jesus in the Way of the Cross, and during the procession he falls from the cross and is hospitalized.

videos.title: Time of Togetherness
videos.overview: A man retires so he can travel the world with his wife and leaves his company to his three children in equal shares, but none of them agree and they fight for absolute control of the company.

videos.title: Repeating History
videos.overview: A single mother is very worried about her daughter because she does not trust her new boyfriend. The mother forbids the young woman from continuing the relationship, and she decides to run away from home to be with him.

videos.title: A Search for Love
videos.overview: A young woman becomes pregnant and her parents force her to give her daughter up for adoption. Years later, one of her sons falls ill with leukemia.

videos.title: A Difficult Path to Take
videos.overview: In a fire, a firefighter loses a leg and becomes disabled. His fiancée leaves him, gets married, and starts a family. She later becomes a widow with a daughter, and the firefighter decides to help them financially.

videos.title: Basket Tacos
videos.overview: A couple opens a taco restaurant and gives their two children the best education at the most expensive schools, but when the children grow up, they reject them because they are ashamed that they are poor.

videos.title: Lupito
videos.overview: A young woman has sex with her boyfriend and becomes pregnant, but he does not want to take responsibility. The young woman goes to a hospital to have an abortion because she does not want to disappoint her parents.

videos.title: A Light of Hope
videos.overview: A woman desperately wants to have a child, and her mother tries to help her, but things get complicated, putting them both at risk. Only a miracle can save them.

videos.title: Follow Your Heart
videos.overview: After an accident, Carmela becomes disabled and her daughter Esperanza decides to take care of her, despite being very young. Forty years later, Esperanza is still single and Carmela, realizing her daughter's loneliness, prays for her.

videos.title: Relieve Yourself
videos.overview: A mother has two very different sons. One of them is an electronic music DJ and has a rebellious personality. The mother finds drugs and accuses him, but appearances are deceiving.

videos.title: Starting Over
videos.overview: A young woman has to flee because her life and that of her two children are in danger. To save her daughter, the mother leaves her with a woman. Fifteen years pass, and the mother lives with her son, who thinks he is an only child, but fate has a surprise in store for them.

videos.title: Cuando un ángel baja al infierno
Otra manera de ser un ángel
A las puertas de tu amor
